name: Admin Accounting Project Bulk Assign
description: The bulk bar on the hostings and incomes tables gains an "Asignar: Cliente | Proyecto" toggle. The Proyecto target opens a catalog-wide combobox (every project, searched by name or client, actives first) and the confirmation shows the exact plan before anything runs: who gains the project, who changes project (origins named), who is already there, and - the bucket the client flavour does not have - the rows of ANOTHER client the ownership rule refuses to touch (blocked, never in the payload; the backend enforces the same rule with 409 client_mismatch/mismatched_ids and the page drops exactly those ids). Quitar proyecto is its own destructive action, clearing is allowed across clients (removing a link needs no owner), and the response rows rebuild the table in place - cascaded liquid children included on incomes. The client bulk preview now also announces which rows will lose their project when the client changes hands.
